patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My daughter had it two weeks ago and now I've got it, which is humiliating enough. But since yesterday I can't get a proper breath and I've got this dry cough that won't stop.
presentation.triageNote: 41-year-old male smoker on day four of adult chickenpox, now with a dry cough and breathlessness, a widespread vesicular rash and crackles on auscultation.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because adult varicella with cough, crackles, tachypnea, oxygen saturation 91%, and systemic illness is high risk for respiratory deterioration.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This adult smoker has varicella complicated by lower-respiratory disease and hypoxemia.
clinical.acuityReason: Adult varicella with cough, crackles, tachypnea, oxygen saturation 91%, and systemic illness is high risk for respiratory deterioration.
teachingPoints: Adults get far sicker than children, and this patient is already hypoxaemic and tachypnoeic with varicella pneumonia. The oxygen requirement and risk of respiratory deterioration make this a high-risk the assigned acuity presentation.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Isolation, oxygen, antiviral treatment, and respiratory monitoring would require hospital admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 41-year-old man in a t-shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting leaning forward with elbows on his knees, breathing shallowly
aiImageGeneration.expression: flushed, drained and working to breathe
signs: widespread red spots and blisters across the face, neck and arms
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: genuinely unwell and short of breath
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 41-year-old man in a t-shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting leaning forward with elbows on his knees, breathing shallowly. Expression: flushed, drained and working to breathe. Clearly visible: widespread red spots and blisters across the face, neck and arms; shallow fast breathing; a flushed sweaty face. Overall: genuinely unwell and short of breath. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
